name: AriaOS Time Machine & System Snapshots
description: Instant system & configuration restore points (Btrfs subvolumes, Timeshift, and AriaOS atomic config snapshots) with 1-click rollback.

tools.name: list_snapshots
tools.description: List all available system and configuration restore points with timestamps, backend type, and size.

tools.name: create_snapshot
tools.description: Create a new system and user configuration restore point before critical changes or package updates.

tools.name: restore_snapshot
tools.description: Restore system or user configurations from a specific snapshot ID.

tools.name: delete_snapshot
tools.description: Delete an existing snapshot by its ID to free storage space.
